_doc: Every room the people on the line can be in, and every sound that happens there — made once each with ElevenLabs' sound effects and kept (see wayne/audio/ambience.py). Scenes are looping beds; sounds come in distances (near, mid, far, pass — a drive-by). docs/soundscape.md is this, readable.
